title: Historic Mill of Sanssouci
scope: The reconstructed Historic Windmill of Sanssouci in Potsdam, including its octagonal brick base, working gallery, slate-clad smock, cap and 24-metre sail cross.
limitations: The cap is shown in a representative parked orientation and the sails remain stationary.
Roof profiles, timber dimensions and rear enclosure details are estimated from the available photograph and mapped structures.
